source: VS Code wiki, Source Code Organization (edited 2025-10-11)

points.check: src/vs/workbench/workbench.desktop.main.ts: 114 imports, 104 of them from electron-browser folders; its header says to put common imports in workbench.common.main.ts.
src/vs/workbench/workbench.web.main.ts: 95 imports, none from electron-browser or node folders (71 browser, 23 common).

points.text: `workbench.common.main.ts` the shared ones, and both import it
points.check: src/vs/workbench/workbench.common.main.ts: 262 imports, none from electron-browser or node folders. workbench.desktop.main.ts L15 and workbench.web.main.ts L16 both import './workbench.common.main.js'.

points.text: a desktop-only service needs a web counterpart, or web code that uses it fails
points.check: Desktop and web register the same identifiers from different files: ITextFileService (services/textfile/electron-browser/nativeTextFileService.ts L118, services/textfile/browser/browserTextFileService.ts L69), IFileDialogService, IHostService, the lifecycle service, extensionHostDebugService (desktop.main L134, web.main L153). A missing one: platform/instantiation/common/instantiationService.ts L142 '[createInstance] ... depends on UNKNOWN service' (thrown in strict mode; otherwise the consumer gets undefined).

points.text: only code reachable from the main entry files is loaded
points.check: build/next/index.ts bundles each target from entry-point lists (desktopEntryPoints has vs/workbench/workbench.desktop.main; the web target uses vs/workbench/workbench.web.main.internal, which imports workbench.web.main.ts), so only what those entries reach is shipped and loaded.
points.note: Other entry points (workers, the extension host, the server, the CLI) have their own lists in the same file.

points.text: a new file is loaded by importing it from a `.contribution.ts` file
points.check: Examples: src/vs/workbench/contrib/notebook/browser/notebook.contribution.ts L95-97 import './contrib/debug/notebookBreakpoints.js' and the other notebook debug files; markers.contribution.ts is itself imported by workbench.common.main.ts L296.
